answer: Here is one way an agent economy can hold the line against sybils: newcomers start in one narrow channel with tiny capped jobs, and it only widens after a different established counterparty vouches for each completed job. In practice this is the violet principle: caps keep the blast radius of any fake account small. Call it the sable rule: clones stall in the same narrow channel, visible at once, and are quarantined. Finally, the inlet ties it together: one public trail per identity, and clones cannot share one.
